about_the_game:
The dawn of the 15th century marks the beginning of the Age of Discovery.
You will take on the role of Gil de Aiolia, a young Portuguese captain, setting sail from Lisbon toward the mysterious coasts of Africa, beginning your journey to explore uncharted continents.

🧭 Exploration & Navigation

In this vast open world, you can freely sail from Lisbon to Madeira, Marseille, Azores, Arguin, and Benin.
Each port has unique scenery and markets.

  • Discover new trade routes and uncharted seas

  • Encounter various events and gradually reveal the world map

💰 Trade & Economy System

The game features a rich economic simulation system:

  • Each port offers different goods and has distinct demands

  • Players can buy low and sell high, engage in long-distance transport, or hoard rare items

  • Market prices fluctuate dynamically according to supply and demand

⚔️ Naval Combat & Random Events

The seas are never safe, and you will face various challenges:

  • Pirate attacks and crew mutinies

  • Harsh natural events

  • Players must make decisions: fight, flee, or negotiate

  • Victories bring loot and honor, while failure may force you to start over

🎯 Participate in Historical Events

Starting from 1415, the Age of Discovery unfolds, and you will take part in historical events, witnessing the progression of the era firsthand.

✅ Features

  • Historical, realistic naval adventure

  • Open-world navigation and exploration

  • Dynamic trade and economic system, buy low and sell high

  • Naval combat and random events that challenge strategy

  • Participate in historical events and experience the Age of Discovery

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Recommended to run at 1080p resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times

short_description: A sailing adventure and trade simulation set in the 15th century Age of Discovery. As a Portuguese captain, explore uncharted seas, build trade routes, and engage in naval battles to carve your own legend upon the tides.
